heroHeadline: Madrid Residency Night 3 — 192,000+ Fans Through Three Sold-Out Shows; Second Back-to-Back Cluster Opens
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny performs Night 3 of his historic 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid on June 2, 2026, opening the second consecutive-night cluster (June 2–3). Through three sold-out shows (Nights 1–3 at ~64,000 per night), the residency has drawn 192,000+ fans — on pace toward the 640,000 projected across all 10 nights (May 30–June 15), the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history. Each night has delivered a unique guest moment: Night 1 (May 30) featured the first-ever live performance between Bad Bunny and Myke Towers, joining for 'Adivino' and a medley of shared tracks; Night 2 (May 31) brought Dominican-American rapper Luar La L to 'La Casita' for 'Teléfono Nuevo.' Night 3 coverage is still emerging as the show concluded during local evening hours. 'DtMF' holds at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 61st consecutive week (chart dated May 30, 2026) — the all-time record. Spotify monthly listeners remain at 114.1M on tour momentum. After Madrid, the DtMF World Tour plays Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28 — first UK stadium dates), and closes in Brussels on July 22.
